details: T. Rowe Price has launched TKNZ, a new $15 million actively managed multi-token spot crypto ETF on NYSE Arca. This fund is positioned as the first of its kind, with initial assets primarily from an affiliate. Its portfolio is notably overweight in Hyperliquid (HYPE) at 6.45%, alongside significant allocations to Bitcoin (40.75%) and Ethereum (18.42%), signaling growing institutional interest in diversified crypto exposure.
title: T. Rowe Price Debuts Actively Managed Multi-Token Crypto ETF TKNZ

details: Japan's Parliament has approved legislation that reclassifies cryptocurrencies as financial instruments, moving their oversight under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. This significant shift paves the way for spot Bitcoin ETFs and will reduce the maximum crypto capital gains tax from 55% to a flat 20%. The new regulatory framework is expected to take effect in 2027, with the favorable tax rate following in 2028.
title: Japan Reclassifies Crypto as Financial Asset, Sets 20% Tax Rate

details: The crypto market experienced significant volatility, leading to the liquidation of over 102,000 traders within the last 24 hours. Total liquidated positions ranged from $942 million to over $1 billion, with the majority being leveraged long positions. This indicates substantial losses for many investors and a reset of leverage in the derivatives market, reflecting fragile risk sentiment.
title: Over 102K Crypto Traders Liquidated Amid Market Volatility

details: Citadel Securities has completed a $400 million strategic investment in Crypto.com, valuing the digital asset platform at $20 billion. This marks Crypto.com's inaugural institutional funding round and is aimed at accelerating its expansion into tokenized securities and derivatives. The investment underscores a growing convergence between digital assets and traditional financial markets.
title: Citadel Securities Makes $400M Strategic Investment in Crypto.com

details: Coinbase has partnered with Spiko to integrate its payment infrastructure, enabling Europe's first regulated mutual funds (UCITS) to accept stablecoin payments, specifically USDC and EURC. This innovation allows for near-instant subscriptions and redemptions, eliminating traditional multi-day settlement delays and facilitating 24/7 capital movement between stablecoins and T-bills, marking a significant step towards crypto integration in traditional finance.
title: Coinbase Powers Europe's First Stablecoin-Funded UCITS Mutual Funds

details: Satsuma Technology, a London-based company, has missed its final proxy deadline regarding a proposal to sell its entire Bitcoin treasury, comprising 668.48 BTC, and delist from the London Stock Exchange. A shareholder meeting on July 20 will decide the outcome, which could see the firm distribute cash to shareholders and potentially end its involvement in the listed Bitcoin treasury model.
title: London Firm Votes to Sell Entire Bitcoin Treasury, Delist

details: A new permanent capital company, ORANGE JUICE, has raised $40 million with the aim of acquiring stable U.S. businesses and channeling their cash flows into a Bitcoin treasury. Backed by prominent figures like Ricardo Salinas, this model seeks to accumulate Bitcoin organically through operating revenues, providing a more sustainable and less capital-raise-dependent approach compared to traditional Bitcoin holding companies.
title: ORANGE JUICE Secures $40M for Bitcoin Treasury Holding Company

details: The chair of the EU's Anti-Money Laundering Authority (AMLA) has issued a warning regarding potential compliance challenges and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) risks for crypto service providers (VASPs). This comes as the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation's transitional period ended on July 1, leading to anticipated mass user migration that could strain firms winding down operations and licensed companies onboarding new users.
title: AMLA Warns of AML Risks Post-MiCA Transition Amid User Migration

details: Bybit, a leading cryptocurrency exchange, has reported significantly lower BTC spot trading slippage in Q1 2026 compared to other major exchanges. Its Rapid Price Improvement (RPI) mechanism consistently delivered superior execution quality, with average slippage for $10,000 orders being 52-84% lower than competitors. This indicates enhanced trading efficiency and reduced costs for its users.
title: Bybit Achieves Lowest BTC Spot Slippage Among Major Exchanges in Q1 2026
